author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Open positions: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter.
